source.rule: Installed manual physical p196 states that when no MissionOperationalModes entry is given, <DEFAULT> mode is assumed and all items/subsystems operate in series.

configuration.parent: Accepted G09.var01 one-aircraft three-mission mixed input: BASIC h8/h32 maps to explicit G09 series and PAR h20 maps to G04 parallel; B h8.62763 critical/abort, B h20.8222 noncritical/success, A h33.0996 critical/abort.
configuration.default: Delete only the PAR-MISSION/TEACH-AIR-01/G04-OPS row from MissionOperationalModes and change ProblemDescription. Retain both explicit RBDs and material modes in source; PAR mission schedule, physical failure modes/rates, CM, seed1, replication1, horizon36 and BASIC mapping remain fixed.

pre_run_hypotheses: Native conversion has zero errors or unreviewed diagnostics and exact populated-table import/export roundtrip. Omitting the PAR row is accepted, not treated as an orphaned mission-mode error.

PAR-MISSION at h20 still has a physical POS-B failure. Under documented <DEFAULT> series behavior this B fault is critical and aborts, contrasting with the accepted explicit-parallel PAR success. Exact event time is empirical, although the fixed physical input and seed support a matched-event check.
BASIC h8/h32 remains on explicit series; report reconciles mission outcomes, failure/repair counts, no stock movement and terminal readiness.
native_acceptance: Unique guarded session-0 SSH native run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source/control fingerprints and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report and 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay comparing explicit PAR mapping to omitted-mode PAR outcome, without claiming selected mode is printed by native log.
diagnostic_gate: If PAR h20 lacks the B event or does not classify it critically, retain the run as diagnostic and revise with new version/run ID; do not change this frozen hypothesis.
limits: One omitted mission-system mode row, one aircraft, three missions and one seed/replication; does not generalize defaults for every material hierarchy, other missions or REL options.
Default series selection is manual/source/outcome based because the native event log may not print <DEFAULT>. No GUI drawing, population reliability or cross-engine claim.
